name: InitCurveSpan
evidence: copies a 16-byte quadratic (three coefficients) into the span, stores the length n, the middle n/2, a window of half width x*n/2 around it (lo, hi, halfw) and the curve values at lo and at the middle plus y

name: EvalCurveSpan
evidence: returns the quadratic of the span at x/len outside the window [lo, hi], p at its ends and a linear blend between p and q inside it, peaking at q in the middle

name: InitTextPanel
evidence: slot 0 of the T217D_440 element: sets width 640, height 492.8, typing speed 15 and highlight 0x80FFFFFF, then runs InitScreenElement

name: ClearTextPanel
evidence: sets the panel's text to empty (slot 8), clears +0x2FC, the value and both stick floats and sets +0x314 to 0.4

name: SetupTextPanel
evidence: slot 1 of the text panel's table D_0021A440, the slot of SetupScreenElementText in the other screen elements' tables: calls SetupScreenElementText, measures its strings and builds its curve spans and GIF packets

name: DrawCompassStrip
evidence: DrawTextPanel's top strip: eleven ticks scrolled by 0x314 and the names of the current, previous and next of the eight compass points (D_00261128) around g_camera's heading, each measured and drawn with the panel's font at 0x310

name: DrawTextPanelControlLabels
evidence: original assembly draw helper DrawTextPanel calls after DrawCompassStrip: draws a frame with func_001613C0/func_00161708/func_00161670, then the strings Move and Zoom (D_00249CE8, D_00249CF0) and a %c glyph (D_00249CE0, formatted with func_001E1FD0) with DrawFontString at fixed positions, picking by the panel's open flag at 0x25C and the value at 0x260

name: DrawTextPanelCenterFrame
evidence: DrawTextPanel's frame around GetTextPanelCenter: advances the spin at the panel's angle with the right stick (pad record 0x78), picks two colours by the palette and state, and draws the curved edges (EvalCurveSpan on D_002612E0) and the dotted rows scaled by g_camera's 0x478

name: DrawTextPanelBorders
evidence: DrawTextPanel's full-width bands: three colours mixed from D_002610E0/D_002610D8 by the spin's cosine, then the curves D_00261280 and D_002612B0 across the 640-pixel screen with 4-pixel offsets

name: DrawTextPanelBlocks
evidence: in state 1 draws four quads whose colour fades toward blockA by blockB with the clock, when a button mask from func_00160D30 is held

name: SetTextPanelMode
evidence: slot 16 of the panel table: when the mode changes from or to 0 hands every object of the world group (0x105, 0x495) func_0012F6B0 with 0.0 or 1.0, then calls SetScreenElementMode

name: SetTextPanelState
evidence: changes the panel state at +0x260 (running ClearTextPanel when leaving 0, a sound when leaving 1 and another when entering 1) and stamps the clock in +0x264

name: CompareEntriesByAttachedKey
evidence: sort comparator: an entry whose object is not attached sorts first, otherwise ordered by the key field

name: CompareEntriesFlaggedLast
evidence: sort comparator: an entry whose object has a non-zero GetNumberedItemFlag orders after the other (returns 1 if a is flagged, -1 if b is), else by key

name: CollectPanelEntriesOfClass
evidence: RefreshPanelEntries calls it for the world objects of class 0x2E and of class 0x21 (lists at 0x1D44/0x1D54 of D_00275710), with ReadPanelEntryPosition and ReadAdjustedPanelEntryPosition as the position callbacks

name: ReadPanelEntryPosition
evidence: a position callback RefreshPanelEntries hands CollectPanelEntriesOfClass: copies the object's 16 bytes at 0x140 and clears the flag

name: ReadAdjustedPanelEntryPosition
evidence: the other position callback of RefreshPanelEntries: copies the object's 16 bytes at 0x140 and passes them to func_001A1F40 with mode 1

name: ReleasePanelEntries
evidence: when the state differs, releases the handle of each of the panel's counted entries (clearing blockB, or with another call when flag is 0), zeroes the counts and blockA and stores the new state at +0x328

name: RefreshPanelEntries
evidence: when the button mask from func_00160D10 does not include the flag it releases the entries, else sets state 1 and adds two entries from fields 0x1D44 and 0x1D54 of the world context

name: UpdatePanelStick
evidence: slot 4 of the panel table: in state 1 clamps the pad axes, eases stickX and stickY toward them 50 times scaled with func_001EA818 and moves +0x314, in state 5 sets stickY to 50; then RefreshPanelEntries

name: SetTextPanelOpen
evidence: slot 3 of the panel table: opens or closes it, setting palette 0, mode 2 or 0 and restoring or releasing the entries (bank) around it

name: ResetTextPanel
evidence: slot 5 of the panel table: runs ResetScreenElement and then func_00150790 on the child with 2

name: SetTextPanelText
evidence: slot 8 of the panel table: copies the text, lays it out with the font at width 280 (380 in state 4), records the index of each line break in lineBreaks and stamps textSince

name: IsTextPanelTextTyped
evidence: true when the text is empty or (clock - textSince) * charsPerSecond has reached the text's character count

name: SetTextPanelSubject
evidence: stores the object at 0x2FC: ClearTextPanel passes 0, HandleStepSequenceMessage the object FindFirstObjectById finds for class 0x104

name: SetTextPanelValuePercent
evidence: stores its argument divided by 100 clamped to 0..1 in the value at +0x300

name: GetTextPanelSlideInTime
evidence: slot 11 of the panel table: 0 in states 1, 2 and 5, otherwise the base slide-in time

name: GetTextPanelSlideOutTime
evidence: the twin of GetTextPanelSlideInTime: 0 in states 1, 2 and 5, otherwise GetScreenElementSlideOutTime

name: DrawTextPanel
evidence: slot 9 of D_0021A440, the draw slot (DrawScreenElementText, DrawPauseMenu): draws the frames by state (func_00132500 and the others), the box in the style's colour, the text typed so far with a blinking cursor scrolled to the line being typed (DrawAlignedText), and the pulsing button glyph (DrawFontString)

name: GetTextPanelCenter
evidence: returns the panel's stick position plus (320, 180.4)

name: ChooseTextPanelState
evidence: slot 6 of the panel table: with a child, sets state 2, 3 or 4 by the child's mode at +0x2D0 and calls func_00150790 with 3; without one sets state 1

name: EndTextPanelState
evidence: slot 7 of the panel table, after ChooseTextPanelState: with a child it sets the child's step sequence to state 4, without one it puts the panel back in state 0 (SetTextPanelState)

name: ConstructTextPanelStatics
evidence: the compiler's static initialiser of this file: when called with a nonzero first argument and 0xFFFF it builds the PanelColor globals D_002610D0..D_00261118 and the two PanelStyle globals D_00261148 and D_00261168 (bytes zero until then)

name: SetTextLayoutPosition
evidence: the text layout's setter of x and y (Layout_137228::Pos, written out by this file); DrawTextPanel and the screen-element and menu draw code call it

name: SetTextLayoutSize
evidence: the text layout's setter of width and height at 0x8/0xC (Layout_137228::Size)

name: SetTextLayoutColor
evidence: the text layout's setter of the 32-bit colour at 0x10 (Layout_137228::Color)

name: SetTextLayoutHorizontalAlign
evidence: stores its argument at +0x14 of the text layout (Layout_137228::SetF14); DrawFontString aligns each line left when it is 0, right when it is 2 and centred otherwise from it

name: SetTextLayoutVerticalAlign
evidence: stores its argument at +0x18 of the text layout (Layout_137228::SetF18); DrawFontString places the text at the top of the rectangle when it is 0, at the bottom when 2 and centred otherwise

name: ConstructTextPanelStaticsAtStartup
evidence: the file's entry in the initialiser list D_0027B130: calls ConstructTextPanelStatics(1, 0xFFFF)
